finalText:
**Redis died and took the whole service with it.**

At `02:14:07` Redis refused connections at `10.0.0.12:6379`.
The cache went dark. Every read hit the database directly.
Three seconds later the first 5-second timeouts started.
The request backlog climbed steadily from 52 to 568.
It passed the 500 ceiling at `02:29:12`.
At `02:31:44` `worker-2` ran out of memory and died.
At `02:31:52` the supervisor killed the API. Service down, 17 minutes after Redis went.

Redis never came back. All 13 reconnect attempts failed, 80 seconds apart, with no backoff.
The 188 errors are nearly all that one timeout repeating.

One oddity: every line is dated `2026-07-04`, not last night.
